# `Q-0-1` — Internal Error

> An error condition that points at a bug in Quarto itself.

## What this means

`Q-0-1` is the catalog's sentinel for errors that should not
occur during normal operation. The condition was reached by a
code path Quarto did not expect to reach — an invariant
violated, a defensive `unreachable!` taken, a state machine
that landed in an unexpected branch.

If you are seeing it, you have most likely found a bug.

## Why this happens

The trigger varies — by definition, `Q-0-1` is what Quarto
emits when it does not have a more specific code that fits.
The accompanying message names the immediate condition; the
context (the document, the configuration, the command line)
is what reproduces it.

## How to fix

Report the failure at the Quarto issue tracker. The most
useful report includes:

- The Quarto version (`quarto --version`).
- The command you ran.
- The full error output.
- A minimal reproducer, if you can construct one.

If the error blocks work you need to ship, you may be able to
find a workaround by changing the input that triggers it
(a different output format, a different configuration option).
The workaround does not fix the underlying problem but can
unblock you while the bug is investigated.
